rationale: LongRangeVdW enum lacks SixthPower entry. PME grid part likely defaults to Lorentz-Berthelot, which assumes 12-6 parameters and mixing. This causes a mismatch between real-space and reciprocal-space at the cutoff, leading to energy injection.

mode: Exclusion Mask Handling in Plain-C Kernels
rationale: 9-6 repulsion disables SIMD and falls back to plain-C kernels. These kernels might have a bug in handling exclusion masks for large systems that was not captured by the 4-atom fixture.

mode: Missing fshift in Reference Non-bonded Kernel
rationale: kernel_ref_inner.h used for n!=12 does not update fshift vectors. This leads to an incorrect virial tensor for grid-based non-bonded interactions in periodic systems, causing massive pressure instability.

mode: Hardcoded HIP Kernel for Non-12 Repulsion
rationale: nbnxm_hip_kernel_body.h has hardcoded 1/12 factors and r^-12 forces. This is fundamentally wrong for 9-6 systems and will cause severe force/energy errors on AMD hardware.
